name: Boll's Journey
detailed_description:
What kind of game is Boll's Journey?

Boll's Journey is a top-down puzzle adventure where you play as Boll — a mysterious glowing sphere with a past, a purpose, and a not-so-obvious future. Fight your way through hostile Shapes, solve puzzles, outrun Appearing Shapes, weave through bush-filled mazes, and uncover a cryptic story across shape-infested battlefields and surreal dimensions.

Puzzles & Strategy

Use as little energy as possible to make it as far as you can. Hit Buttons (in the right order) to pass through gates, or eliminate (or leave) the right Shapes to unlock the path forward.

Nature vs Geometry

Nature pushes back against the Shapes' expansion, forming maze-like paths and chaotic battle zones. Be careful not to get caught in the crossfire between wild terrain and synthetic invaders.

Story & Exploration

Travel through gardens, parks, suburbs, cities, jungles, and beyond in a seemingly never-ending journey — slowly piecing together what Boll is, why you're helping them, where the Shapes came from, and what it all means.

Voices will whisper. Some will guide. Others may deceive. Who do you trust?

Changing landscapes

The world is vast and always shifting. You'll explore:

  • Gardens

  • Suburbs

  • Highways

  • Forests

…with more regions planned for future updates.

short_description: Zoom through the landscape as Boll, a mysterious glowing sphere, uncovering a forgotten past and the truth behind the world they've landed in. Gather all sorts of collectibles, evading Shapes and Nature alike. Uncover the mysteries...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Dual-Core Processor (2.0GHz)
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or Better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most systems made after 2015
